class.name: GIFTexture
class.brief_description: A self-contained animated [Texture2D] that decodes, stores, and plays a GIF.
class.description: GIFTexture is the single resource for GIF content: it owns the decoded frame data and its playback state. Assign it to [Sprite2D], [Sprite3D], [TextureRect], materials, or shader uniforms like any other [Texture2D]. Importing a [code].gif[/code] file produces a GIFTexture. Each scene instance gets its own copy ([member Resource.resource_local_to_scene] is enabled by default), so playback state never leaks between instances; use "Make Unique" when two nodes in the same scene must play independently. Looping honors [member netscape_loop_count] while [member loop] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: add_source_frame
method.description: Appends a raw frame with delay (centiseconds), disposal method, and canvas offset.

method.name: bake_frames
method.description: Composites source frames (disposals, offsets, transparency) into full-canvas baked frames.

method.name: from_sprite_frames
method.description: Creates a GIFTexture from a [SpriteFrames] animation.

method.name: get_active_texture
method.description: Returns the composited texture for a frame index.

method.name: get_baked_image
method.description: Returns the baked full-canvas image of a frame.

method.name: get_source_image
method.description: Returns the raw source image of a frame.

method.name: load_from_buffer
method.description: Decodes GIF data into this texture, replacing all frames.

method.name: load_from_path
method.description: Decodes a GIF file into this texture, replacing all frames.

method.name: save_to_buffer
method.description: Encodes the current frames as GIF data.

method.name: save_to_path
method.description: Encodes the current frames as a GIF file.

method.name: to_sprite_frames
method.description: Converts the frames to a [SpriteFrames] animation.

method.name: wrap_frame
method.description: Wraps an arbitrary frame index into the valid range.

members.member: Whether baked frames are stored in the resource or regenerated on load.
Logical canvas size of the GIF.
Whether rendering uses raw source frames or composited baked frames.
If [code]true[/code], playback repeats according to [member netscape_loop_count].
Netscape loop count from the file: 0 loops forever, N plays N times.
If [code]true[/code], the texture advances frames. Non-looping playback automatically clears this when the animation finishes; setting it again restarts from frame 0.
Playback speed. Negative values play in reverse.

signal.name: frames_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the frame data changes (load, add_source_frame, reimport).

signal.name: rebaked
signal.description: Emitted after [method bake_frames] composites new baked frames.
